issues.description: The problem UML and specification state that Animal has an attribute 'name' of type String, but the provided solution implements the backing field as a StringBuilder (private StringBuilder name). This is an attribute type mismatch that deviates from the UML and could confuse students about the expected field type and simple getter/setter semantics.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a String for the Animal.name attribute to match the UML and problem specification (private String name) and update the constructor, getter, and setter accordingly, or update the UML/spec to explicitly allow StringBuilder if that was intended. Prefer changing the solution to use String to avoid student confusion.
